Business Name Generator

Brainstorm business names by industry — prefix + suffix combos with industry keywords and an optional domain-style version.

📖 How to use

  1. Select your industry.
  2. Tick domain-style if you want a web-ready version.
  3. Press Generate, then click any name to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the names built?

Each result pairs a brandable prefix with a suffix (like Labs or Studio) plus an industry keyword (like Cloud for tech).

What is the domain-style option?

Tick the domain-style option to see a lowercase no-space version with a random TLD, e.g. novacloud.io.

How do I copy a name?

Click any name or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
